youtube_title: Chai At 6 Pm? Awake At 2 Am? It's Still In You | Body Fix #6 #Shorts
youtube_description:
BODY FIX #6. Chai at 6 PM... staring at the ceiling at 2 AM? Same bro.
B is right. About 5 HOURS later, HALF the caffeine is still in your body.
So 6 PM chai is still working at 11. Even if you sleep, it's lighter and broken.
Fix: Last chai or coffee by 2-3 PM. Cola and energy drinks count too.
Red flags: Weeks of no sleep or heart racing? Talk to a DOCTOR.
Not medical advice. See a doctor if it doesn't go away.
Source: Sleep Foundation / FDA - caffeine
